Package it.polimi.ingsw.view

Interface SetupView

All Superinterfaces:
ReconnectableView
All Known Implementing Classes:
SetupCLI, SetupGUI
public interface SetupView extends ReconnectableView
Contains all the headers of the methods used by both the CLI and GUI during the setup phase of the application.

    • updateMatchList

      void updateMatchList(List<GameInfo> matchList)

    • newGameSuccess

      void newGameSuccess(int gameId)
      Notifies that a new game has been created and requests the list of the colors that can be chosen by the players.
      Parameters:
      gameId - the ID of the new game.

    • showCriticalError

      void showCriticalError(String message)
      Allows a custom error message to be shown, following a critical error. An error is "critical" when the client must be returned to the match selection interface, after its occurrence.
      Parameters:
      message - the custom message.

    • showJoinGameDialog

      void showJoinGameDialog(List<Content> colors, int gameId)
      Handles the joining phase to a game. To access a game, the client must choose a unique nickname and a color from the list of the available ones.
      Parameters:
      colors - the list of available colors.
      gameId - the ID of the game the client is joining.
      See Also:
      • Content

    • showUserError

      void showUserError(String message, int gameId)
      Allows a custom error message to be shown, following a non-critical error. Used when the client chooses an invalid nickname or color.
      Parameters:
      message - the custom message.
      gameId - the ID of the game the client is joining.

    • showSuccessfulJoin

      void showSuccessfulJoin(String nickname, Content color, int numberOfPlayers)
      Notifies that the client successfully joined a game.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname chosen by the player.
      color - the color chosen by the player.
      numberOfPlayers - the number of players that can join the game.
      See Also:
      • Content

    • showReconnectionError

      void showReconnectionError(String message)
      Handles the disconnection of the client. When the disconnection occurs, the client is returned to the match selection interface.
      Parameters:
      message - the message printed when a client disconnects.
